items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Buddy didn't go in the home, I don't think, but his old stepdad showed him all that, Joe Petit.

ctx.x: Were many of the guys self-taught in those days on trumpet? You know, did they start out teaching themselves, learning by themselves?
Well, from what I heard, all of them come up with somebody. All of them, yeah. Buddy didn't go in the home, I don't think, but his old stepdad showed him all that, Joe Petit.
What were some of the different kind of dances that they used to do?
